static_traits.name: Han Na
static_traits.social_status: Some relationships affected due to discomfort going out with others
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no similar psychological problems in the past; no history of psychological counseling/treatment
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent logic, able to notice and describe anxiety, fairly cooperative, neutral emotional tone but with anxiety

basic_info.main_problem: Worrying that excessive coffee intake will harm health in the future, producing persistent anxiety and worry; making or drinking coffee always triggers anxiety; tried limiting intake but found it difficult due to dependence and withdrawal reactions.
basic_info.core_demands: Hoping to ease anxiety around coffee intake and reduce distress to daily life, sleep, work performance and interpersonal relationships.

core_beliefs: Without coffee I cannot function normally
Excessive coffee will inevitably harm my health; I will lose control over health

special_situations.event: Moments of making or drinking coffee (several times daily)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I keep drinking coffee, serious health problems will appear in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to limit intake and look up risk information to alert oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This cup will hurt me; I am slowly destroying my body

special_situations.event: Reading reports or research on the harms of coffee
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I see negative evidence, it means I will definitely have problems
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly searches for and focuses on negative information, ignoring or questioning positive evidence
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These studies prove something will happen to me sooner or later

special_situations.event: Trying to limit coffee intake and experiencing restlessness, headaches and other withdrawal reactions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not drink coffee, I cannot focus and complete work
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Quickly resumes drinking coffee to restore functioning
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I do not drink it I cannot complete tasks

special_situations.event: When going out or socializing with friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot get coffee in time, I will collapse or be unable to cope with socializing
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces time with friends or is distracted in socializing, planning the next cup of coffee
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I need a cup right now, otherwise I cannot hold on

core_conflict.wish: Longs to maintain stable control over the body and daily functioning, operating with ease and efficiency
core_conflict.fear: Fears losing control over health and encountering serious consequences (such as heart problems) and being harmed
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of security by monitoring and limiting coffee
Avoids exposing vulnerability and shame in front of others
Reduces fear through rational information gathering

object_relations.self_representation: Feels fragile and vulnerable to health risks, someone who depends on coffee to function
object_relations.object_representation: Dismissive or disapproving others who might think 'this is just making a fuss over nothing'

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others propose viewing coffee risks from a more balanced perspective/suggest reducing consumption
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worries that downplaying risks means losing control over health (experiencing others' suggestions as a threat to her own safety)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Presents mainly with data and research, calm tone, weakens or avoids subjective emotional experience.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing whether to ask friends for help or reveal troubles
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes that once vulnerability is expressed one will be looked down on ('it's just coffee')
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Briefly deny needing help, deflect the topic, not elaborating on the longing for support.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When under high work pressure and advised to cut down on coffee
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes the current task is more important, reducing coffee will lead to failure and loss of control
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasize the urgency of real tasks, postponing change on the grounds that 'now is not the time'.

manifestations: Worries long-term coffee drinking will lead to serious health problems (such as heart problems)
Every time drinking coffee, associating it with future harm and the worst outcomes
Wavers between 'relying on coffee to function' and 'fearing coffee will harm me', experiencing conflict over choice and control
Continuously gathering evidence, setting limits and self-monitoring in pursuit of safety

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact
manifestations: Believes 'this is just coffee, saying it out loud is embarrassing', tending to belittle one's own feelings
In sessions, relies more on rational evidence and expresses emotions cautiously

contact_model.definition: An individual restraining the impulse to act toward other people or things, or giving up seeking others to do something for them and instead doing it to oneself
manifestations: Not discussing one's anxiety and troubles with friends
Turning the need for support into self-control (coping through self-monitoring and limits)

positive_force: Having self-observation ability, able to identify one's catastrophizing and 'predicting the future' thinking
Willing to seek help and accept a gradual, reality-tested plan for change
Having some friend resources (though not yet utilized)
negative_force: Catastrophizing and 'predicting the future' cognitive tendencies, magnifying potential health risks
Physiological and psychological dependence on coffee (withdrawal discomfort, believing one cannot function without drinking it)
Insufficient sleep and disrupted rhythms intensifying the anxiety cycle
Shame and self-denial leading to avoiding help-seeking and socializing

target_behavior.behavior: Excessively drinks coffee (repeatedly brews coffee to stay awake and functioning)
antecedent: Facing work/study tasks that require concentration
target_behavior.core_reason: Believing one cannot focus and complete tasks without coffee, while continuing intake to avoid withdrawal discomfort
target_behavior.function: Gaining energy and focus; avoiding withdrawal discomfort
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep further disrupted, anxiety intensified, work performance and interpersonal relationships impaired

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophizing anxiety and repeated worry around coffee harms
antecedent: Reading articles/research about the negative effects of coffee
target_behavior.core_reason: Fear of losing health control and 'predicting the future' thinking, causing small amounts of negative evidence to be overgeneralized
target_behavior.function: Tries to gain a sense of safety and drive self-restriction through high vigilance and worry
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent tension and worry, sleep disturbance, declining performance, social avoidance
